name: Michael Davis
title: CEO
facts: 20+ years in go-to-market leadership, scaling SaaS ventures and building high-performing teams
Passionate about wine-fueled adventures, trekking vineyard hillsides and unearthing hidden cellars across Europe

bio: Michael Davis is the CEO of FlowFuse. He previously led FlowFuse's global sales team, working closely with manufacturers and industrial operators, and has more than 20 years of experience scaling SaaS companies. He now leads FlowFuse's work building complete industrial solutions with its customers.
